patterns.purpose: Make a modern creative tool feel approachable and personal.
patterns.desktop: A compact central opening followed by a wide demonstration and grouped use cases.
patterns.mobile: Keep one decorative object; product demonstration and CTA remain full width.
patterns.conversion: Show the real result before the download or signup.

patterns.purpose: Present episodes or releases as a coherent collection.
patterns.desktop: One lead sleeve followed by an aligned collection; playback remains conventional.
patterns.mobile: Single-column sleeves with titles and controls outside the art.
patterns.conversion: Listen or subscribe without navigating decorative objects.

patterns.purpose: Sell a specific collection with visible contents and terms.
patterns.desktop: A single large render leads into a catalogue at a consistent camera angle.
patterns.mobile: One or two assets per row depending on label length; no clipped controls.
patterns.conversion: Compare the contents and license before purchase.
